text:
Lina: Quick sync 0m thread 01 - I'm landing a refresh of the bootstrap walkthrough (trimmed, clearer env vars, and an extra "How to deploy" note). PR incoming shortly. Can folks glance at snippets for accuracy? :mag:
Connor: Will do. Heads-up: the Go sample uses `REDWOOD_API_KEY` while the Dockerfile uses `API_KEY`. Which convention are we standardizing on?
Priya: Also saw an inconsistency in the SDK versions: most of the JS examples are v2-style `const client = new Redwood()` but our published SDK is v3 with `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey })`. That will confuse users following quickstart.
Jaz: I ran the sample app deploy locally and Netlify preview failed because the deploy CLI snippet missed `--project-name` and the example domain placeholder isn't valid. We should show a concrete `--project-name my-hello` example and clarify the placeholder text.
Docs Bot: docs-ci started for PR #3222 1 checks queued: build, lint, linkcheck, examples-smoke.
Lina: Thanks. Plan: change all env var mentions to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, update Go/Docker, and update JS snippets to v3 shape. I'll also add `--project-name my-hello --region us-west-2` to the CLI snippet.
Connor: For the Go snippet, can we add a tiny note about Go modules and import path? A one-liner like: `go get github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go@v0.3.0` would help new devs.
Priya: Agree on the JS normalization. Also a request: please avoid inlined types in plain JS codefences. Use `javascript` fences only for JS. Put TypeScript examples in `typescript` fences in a separate block.
Jaz: Linkcheck flagged the custom domain guide link. It points to `/docs/custom-domain` but should be `/deploy/custom-domains/`. Docs Bot: linkcheck failure recorded.
Docs Bot: examples-smoke test failed: quickstart/sample-app test returned 401 when hitting /health. Response: {"error":"missing auth"}.
Lina: That's likely due to the environment mismatch. I'll add a tiny troubleshooting note under the auth section: "If you see 401, ensure REDWOOD_API_KEY is exported and available to the app runtime."
Connor: Minor nit: change the headline "Deploying your first app" -> "Deploying your initial app" to match CLI reference. Consistency helps search.
Priya: I'll take the JS/TS fence split and update the snippets repo with curated examples. Leaving comments on the PR.
Lina: Pushed changes: normalized env var, updated JS to v3, added `--project-name` and `--region` to CLI, added Go `go get` note, and a short troubleshooting block. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/9c4b2f0
Docs Bot: rebuild triggered for PR #3222 1 checks running.
Connor: LGTM on Go and CLI. Left one suggestion to reword the troubleshooting line to be action-first.
Jaz: Re-ran local deploy with Lina's CLI example and health check; now returns 200. Approving once CI is green.
Docs Bot: build finished  linkcheck still flags `/deploy/custom-domains/` redirect missing from site redirects. Please coordinate with platform infra for a redirect or update the target page. :link: 
Lina: Merging the docs changes now; I'll open a follow-up issue for the redirect and the examples-smoke test improvement to run the health curl automatically in the sample-app CI. If infra needs to own the redirect, tagging @platform-infra. Thanks all! :tada:
